title: Fynaptix · Quantum Computing Research
heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S 58–483×) and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Revenue $64.7M; backlog $470M (+554%); FY26 guidance $260–270M. Reports Q2 earnings Aug 5 (Rigetti/D-Wave follow Aug 6); Polymarket implies just ~6.5% odds of a beat
9 companies incl. IBM ($1B) & six startups ($100M each, some via equity stakes) — May 2026
IonQ (~58×) / Rigetti (~480×) / D-Wave (~483×) price-to-sales — compressed from 109–836× in May after a ~30–39% one-month sector sell-off, still extreme speculation territory

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: Nighthawk 120-qubit chip; 10x error-correction speedup hit a year ahead of schedule, on track for verified quantum advantage by end-2026; won $1B CHIPS quantum foundry award
rows.watch for: Kookaburra qLDPC rollout; Starling fault-tolerant target 2029

rows.angle: Willow: below-threshold error correction confirmed as grid scaled 3×3→5×5→7×7; new reinforcement-learning calibration framework now autonomously stabilizes logical qubits during continuous operation across distance-5/7 surface codes, cutting manual recalibration
Topological qubit program + Azure Quantum; Quantinuum/Microsoft collab reports 800× logical-vs-physical qubit fidelity on System Model H2
rows.watch for: Majorana milestone reproducibility; Azure path to Level 2 resilient computing

rows.angle: NVQLink (built on CUDA-Q) now publicly available via the cudaq-realtime API — a universal GPU–QPU interconnect adopted by 17 quantum hardware builders and 9 national/scientific labs, incl. Quantinuum's Helios and QuEra
rows.watch for: NVQLink adoption at national labs; hybrid quantum-AI workloads

tiers.label: Pure-Plays — Highly Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: Trapped-ion leader; closed $1.075B Oxford Ionics acquisition (Jan 2026); first 256-qubit Tempo system sold to Univ. of Cambridge; $470M backlog; FY26 revenue guide $260–270M
rows.watch for: Q2 earnings Aug 5 (only ~6.5% Polymarket odds of a beat); P/S compressed to ~58× after July sell-off; pending Vector Atomic (sensing) deal

rows.angle: Superconducting full-stack; intends to invest up to $100M in the UK (first major non-US investment) targeting a 1,000+ qubit system in 3–4 years; landed $8.4M C-DAC order for a 108-qubit system deploying in India in H2 2026; FY26 revenue growth guided ~241% to ~$24M

Quantum annealing + gate-model; completed NYSE→Nasdaq listing transfer Jul 27; AT&T signed an expanded deal layering D-Wave annealing into network-ops AI tooling, cutting a ~1-hour optimization workload to under 15 seconds (stock +8.6% premarket); FY26 revenue growth guided ~79% to ~$44M
rows.watch for: Q2 earnings Aug 6 (Street: EPS -$0.09, rev +30% YoY to ~$4.0M); P/S ~483×

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Reportedly closed a $1.5B round (May 2026) at a ~$10.5B valuation; broke ground on its Moreton Bay Central fault-tolerant facility in Australia; expanded its DARPA agreement to $125M (Jul 22) as one of only two firms in Stage C, the final validation stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative.

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Honeywell-backed; upsized $1.68B IPO raise at $60/share (~$12.7B valuation). Helios system now runs on NVIDIA's NVQLink for real-time quantum error-correction decoding; Microsoft collab reports 800× logical-vs-physical qubit fidelity on System Model H2. SoftBank roadmap: Helios now → Sol 2027 → Apollo 2029 → Lumos 2030s fault tolerance.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: $230M+ raise backed by Google Quantum AI, SoftBank, NVentures; 96 verified logical qubits — industry-leading; now a NVIDIA CUDA-Q/NVQLink integration partner and a selected recipient of Japanese government quantum funding.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: Most systems remain R&D-phase; revenue today is mostly government contracts and research access, not commercial workloads.

bear_case.title: Valuations price in perfection
bear_case.description: Even after P/S multiples compressed from 109–836× (May) to ~58–483× (Jul), decades of flawless execution are still in the price; drawdowns are routine — the trio fell 6-8% in a single session on Jul 13 and are down 30–39% over the trailing month into Q2 earnings (Aug 5–6, 2026).

bear_case.title: Insiders aren't buying
bear_case.description: Insiders at IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave have collectively sold ~$988M in stock over five years versus roughly $4.3M in insider purchases combined (as of Jul 22, 2026) — a persistent gap between executive selling and executive conviction.

bear_case.title: Dilution as a business model
bear_case.description: Pure-plays fund R&D via repeated equity raises; share counts grow relentlessly. CHIPS Act awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and others are structured partly as government equity stakes — another layer of dilution on top.

bear_case.title: Winner may not be listed
bear_case.description: IBM/Google/Microsoft or private Quantinuum/PsiQuantum could reach fault tolerance first, stranding pure-play premiums.

catalysts.title: Q2 earnings: IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave
catalysts.description: IonQ reports Aug 5; Rigetti and D-Wave follow Aug 6. Polymarket implies just ~6.5% odds of an IonQ beat; Street models D-Wave revenue +30% YoY to ~$4.0M with a wider per-share loss. First major print since the sector's July pullback.

catalysts.title: Sector down 30–39% in a month
catalysts.description: IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave shares fell 30–39% over the trailing month amid a broader rotation out of high-multiple, pre-profit tech; Benchmark analyst Gary Mobley reinstated Buy ratings on all three heading into earnings.

catalysts.title: AT&T expands D-Wave quantum deal
catalysts.description: AT&T signs an agreement to broaden its use of D-Wave's annealing technology inside its agentic network-operations tooling; an early test cut a ~1-hour optimization workload to under 15 seconds. QBTS rose as much as 8.6% premarket, lifting IonQ and Rigetti with it.

catalysts.title: D-Wave completes move to Nasdaq
catalysts.description: D-Wave transfers its primary listing from NYSE to Nasdaq under the same QBTS ticker; CEO Alan Baratz rings the opening bell.

catalysts.title: PsiQuantum expands DARPA deal to $125M
catalysts.description: New agreement under DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative; PsiQuantum is one of only two companies to reach Stage C, the program's final validation stage for utility-scale hardware claims.

catalysts.title: Insider-selling warning grows to $988M
catalysts.description: Five-year cumulative insider sales across IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave top $988M against roughly $4.3M in insider buying combined — up from $931M cited in May — a recurring valuation-discipline flag from Wall St. commentary.

etfs.name: Defiance Quantum
etfs.summary: Quantum + advanced computing basket — YTD +29.3% (down from +51% in early July amid the sector-wide pullback), ~$141/share (Jul 31), ~$5.5B AUM; the standard diversified route

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: The most advanced published roadmap attached to a profitable business, so the quantum programme costs you nothing to hold while it plays out.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: Willow and the error-correction work are as good as anything in the field, funded by an ads business that does not care whether it works.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: Topological qubits are the highest-risk, highest-payoff approach — and are a rounding error on Microsoft's income statement.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: CUDA-Q makes it the toolchain layer regardless of which qubit modality wins. Already your largest AI holding, so mind the concentration.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: The most commercially advanced pure-play, valued far ahead of revenue. Position sizing is the whole risk-management strategy here.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: Superconducting pure-play with a persistent funding requirement and no path to profitability in view.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Annealing has real customers but is not the general-purpose quantum computing the valuation implies.
